product_metadata.title: Avalon Bay Air Fryer, For Healthy Oil-Less Fried Food, 3.7 Quart Capacity, Includes Free Airfryer Baking Set, Red, AB-Airfryer100R
features: [Versatile Air Fryer for All Your Cooking Needs] The Avalon Bay 3.7 Quart Standard-Sized Manual Air Fryer is the perfect size to prepare delicious snacks, side dishes and more. Big enough to make a meal for the whole family but small enough to fit neatly on your counter, it's the ideal companion for healthy cooking.

[One of Our Best-Selling Air Fryers] The Avalon Bay 3.7 Quart Standard-Sized Manual Air Fryer is a best seller. Simple controls, reliable functioning and smart safety features make this a favorite among savvy home cooks. All this plus a free recipe book!

[Simple Controls for Fast Start Up] The intuitive control panel has just two simple dials for time and temperature, so there's no learning curve before cooking. Just choose the amount of heat and the length of time you need, and this air fryer does the rest.

[Guilt-Free Frying — For Real!] Love the flavor of fried food but hate the excess grease? Air frying works with the power of convection, not boiling oil. The powerful fan moves hot air quickly and evenly over the surface of your food, crisping it to a perfect golden brown every time — with zero added fat.

[Easy-Clean, Non-Stick Parts] It's a breeze to clean after cooking with the Avalon Bay 3.7 Quart Standard-Sized Manual Air Fryer, thanks to its non-stick interior and dishwasher safe frying basket and accessories, including a baking dish and multi-use rack.
